name: AetherIoT
description: Unified Zero-Heap C++20 Industrial IoT Framework for ESP32/ESP8266. Features 16-channel actuators, 32-servo matrix with relay-like API, TCA9548A I2C MUX, 1-Wire DS18B20 array, rain gauge, BLE serial monitor & OTA, tiered caching, SD Card CSV logging, multi-SSID failover, gateway control modes, multi-scheme payload encryption (AES-128, AES-256-CBC, ChaCha20), LoRa SX1276, PCA9685 PWM dimming, 74HC595 64-relay matrix, dual-engine OTA, embedded real-time Web Dashboard, and declarative safety guards.
